_README: THE CANONICAL LIST OF AFFILIATE AND REFERRAL LINKS. Nothing else on the
site should carry a partner URL that is not in this file.
WHY ONE FILE. Affiliate links go stale, get reissued, and are easy to
half-replace: one page keeps the bare URL, another keeps last year's
tracking code, and there is no way to tell without reading every page.
_dev/affiliate.py reads this file and rewrites every occurrence of `bare`
to `url` across the whole site on every build, so the link exists in
exactly one place and cannot drift.
TO ADD A PARTNER: add a record here and run _dev/affiliate.py. To rotate a
link: change `url` and re-run. To retire one: set `active` to false and
re-run, and every page reverts to the bare URL rather than shipping a dead
tracking link.
FIELDS
slug      internal key, also the anchor on the disclosure page
name      as a reader would say it
url       THE AFFILIATE LINK - the thing that earns
bare      the plain URL it replaces, so pages can be written naturally
extra     other bare URLs that should also be rewritten (deep links)
program   what the arrangement actually is, in plain words
pays      what it pays, if known - null rather than a guess
costs_you what it costs the reader, which for all of these is nothing
active    false takes it out of circulation without deleting the record

partners.name: SimplePractice

partners.program: SimplePractice partner programme. If you start a subscription through this link, the site earns a referral fee.
partners.costs_you: Nothing. The price is the same as going direct, and the trial is the same length.

partners.name: Headway
partners.what: An insurance network that credentials you, bills the payer and pays you a set rate per session.
